meta.title: Landed – apparel import duty & tax dataset
meta.timezone_note: Dates are ISO; rates are % ad valorem on customs value unless stated.

valuation_basis.CA: FOB/transaction value (duty); GST on duty-paid value

meta.never_fabricated: Any rate that could not be verified from an official source is null with a note.
meta.model: Each category has an MFN rate per destination; per-origin records give preferential_rate (if a trade agreement/GSP applies and goods qualify) and extra_tariffs (e.g. US Section 301). effective_rate = (preferential_rate if claimed else mfn_rate) + sum(extra_tariffs.rate). For US "net" 301 headings, rate is already computed as the top-up.

import_taxes.pst_note: BC PST 7%, MB RST 7%, SK PST 6%, QC QST 9.975% are provincial and generally self-assessed/collected by the vendor, not by CBSA on commercial imports (except BC/MB/SK on some courier entries). AB, territories: GST only.
import_taxes.tax_base: GST/HST is charged on value for duty + customs duties (+ excise if any).

de_minimis.note: Courier/postal low-value: non-US/Mexico origin goods ≤ CAD 20 enter free of duty and taxes; US/Mexico-origin courier goods: duty-free ≤ CAD 150, tax-free ≤ CAD 40.

import_taxes.note: No federal VAT/GST on imports. State/local sales tax applies at retail sale, not at import.

MPF.note: Merchandise Processing Fee on formal entries, subject to an annually adjusted min/max (FY2026 min/max not re-verified here – check CBP user-fee notice).

HMF.note: Harbor Maintenance Fee, ocean shipments only.

de_minimis.note: $800 Section 321 de minimis suspended for all countries/modes since 29 Aug 2025 (EO 14324, continued by EO 14388 after the IEEPA ruling); codified by CBP interim final rules (24 Jun 2026) and upheld by the CIT (13 Aug 2026). Statutory repeal from 1 Jul 2027. Every shipment needs an entry and pays duty.

tariff_regime_status.ieepa: Ended. SCOTUS Learning Resources v. Trump (20 Feb 2026); collection stopped 24 Feb 2026; refunds via CBP CAPE.
tariff_regime_status.section_122: 10% surcharge (9903.03.01) ran 24 Feb–24 Jul 2026 and lapsed.
tariff_regime_status.section_301_2026: Forced-labour Section 301 duties on 60 economies from 24 Jul 2026 (9903.05.20–.84): flat +10% or +12.5%, or top-up to 10%/12.5% for EU, Japan, Korea, Switzerland, Taiwan.
tariff_regime_status.section_301_china: 2018–19 China lists still in force (List 4A 7.5% on most apparel/footwear; List 3 25% on leather handbags 4202.21).

UK.name: United Kingdom
UK.tariff_source: UK Global Tariff via UK Trade Tariff API

import_taxes.note: Import VAT 20% (measure 305 on every line checked). VAT-registered importers can use postponed VAT accounting.

de_minimis.vat_note: VAT is charged at the point of sale (by the seller/marketplace) on B2C consignments ≤ £135; no import-VAT relief.
de_minimis.change: Duty relief for ≤ £135 is being removed on a date the Treasury sets, by October 2028 at the latest.

EU.name: European Union
EU.tariff_source: EU Common Customs Tariff / TARIC, as published by the UK Trade Tariff XI (Northern Ireland) service, which applies the EU tariff

import_taxes.note: Import VAT is charged at the rate of the member state of import on customs value + duty. 21% used as a typical default; standard rates range 17% (LU) to 27% (HU). VAT rates not re-verified individually this run – confirm on the Commission VAT rates database.

de_minimis.note: €150 customs-duty relief abolished 1 Jul 2026 (Council Reg. (EU) 2026/382). Temporary €3 customs duty per item (per tariff classification) for B2C distance-sale consignments ≤ €150 until 1 Jul 2028; goods claiming preference can be declared normally. TARIC also shows a €2 "Union handling fee" (measure 800) from 1 Nov 2026 – scope/amount to confirm. No VAT de minimis (IOSS for ≤ €150).

caveats: Rates are for the specific tariff lines listed per category; a different fibre, construction, gender, value band or weight can change the line and rate.
Preferential rates only apply if the goods meet the agreement/program rules of origin and the importer holds valid proof of origin; otherwise use the MFN path.
US Section 301 duties stack on MFN and, except USMCA and CAFTA-DR apparel, apply even when an FTA rate is claimed.

For the US "top-up" 301 headings (EU, JP, KR, CH, TW) with an FTA claim (e.g. KORUS), how the top-up interacts with the FTA rate was not verified; the preferential path assumes the computed top-up still applies.
